name: x2611_15358_triple_common_bound
statement: (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 14)) (hdeg : ∀ v : Fin 14, 4 ≤ Nat.card (G.neighborSet v)) (hq : Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet ≤ 15) (S : Finset (Fin 14)) (hS : S.card = 3) : x2611_15358_t G S ≤ (Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet) / 3 ∧ (Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet) / 3 ≤ 5
closed: ∀ (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 14)) (hdeg : ∀ v : Fin 14, 4 ≤ Nat.card (G.neighborSet v)) (hq : Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet ≤ 15) (S : Finset (Fin 14)) (hS : S.card = 3), x2611_15358_t G S ≤ (Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet) / 3 ∧ (Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet) / 3 ≤ 5
informal: Lemma 2.6, proof (common neighbors of a triple)
original:
For an unordered triple $S$ , put $t_{S}=|\bigcap_{x\in S}N_{G^{c}}(x)|$ .
The $3t_{S}$ edges between $S$ and its common neighbors are distinct, so $t_{S}\leq\lfloor q/3\rfloor\leq 5$ .
